nodes.title: First RUn
widgets_values:
shut off the import node, it will throw an error if you don't actually have a saved refmod yet, so all imports should be 'none'.  Use the refmod maker path first, after 1st gen a refmod will save. then use 'R' to reload files in comfyui canvas and should be able to pick the saved refmod for the 1st slot.

Local save path should be:
ComfyUI\models\refmods

make directory first if it doesn't exist

Also - make sure prompt_hint attached to concatenate with the main video prompt

nodes.title: Notes on RefMod Concept
widgets_values:
Two extraction modes: full (stores the real VAE-encoded reference at your chosen resolution — this is what carries identity) and pooled (average-pooled into a small grid — cheap, but only carries concept/motion, not fine identity). Pick based on whether you need "looks exactly like this" vs "vibe like this."

Pool size is now the concept↔identity dial: 8×8 pooling keeps the general idea (colors, look, a motion) and lets the model improvise details. 16×16 keeps more specific detail but also risks copying framing/background from your source data.

reference resolution minimal faster — higher resolution increases token count and slows the workflow further.

max_token cap (default ~5120) — It hard-caps how many tokens a mod can contribute regardless of resolution, so you get a real speed benefit with lower, higher and it approaches native ref image loading concept

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
the Amazon warrior woman long dark mahogany hair in two long fierce warrior braids running through the woods with sword in hand. tracking action head-on shot. she jumps over a log in the path, the camera goes to slow motion mid air jump action, cut to a behind view over the shoulder of the woman still in slow motion as she throws and her hand releases her sword while she is still in mid air, in the distance there is an Orc Warrior on the path, the camera changes to fast speed and follows the sword through the air, the hilt barly visible near the bottom of frame looking down the length of the sword as it travels and the tip of the sword hits the Orc in the chest, burring in to his chest the sword hilt still visible, camera returns to normal speed, the sword deep in to the Orc's chest as blood spurts from it's body, the Orc yelps in pain and grips the sword with its hand, the sword wobbling still from the impact, and the Orc falls down dead. Camera turns 180 degrees to show the woman on the path in the distance and does a rapid push zoomback to the woman who is in a three point stance on the, her hands are empty empty now, the the camera pushes in on her face as she stands up straight and she cracks a small smile then she says <d>[English]I'm just getting started</d>

overall_soundscape:the sound of her panting rapid breaths, her footsteps on the ground, the woosh of the slow motion action, the snaral of a Orc the impact of the sword in its chest
non_diegetic_music: low action movie soundtrack
